# LLM-Estimated Diagnostic Likelihood Ratios

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/llm_estimate_lrs
Article: Large language models generate diagnostic likelihood ratios with low mean bias but wide dispersion
DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-61766-2
Status: Published online in Scientific Reports on 11 July 2026 as a citable, unedited early-access article; publisher production editing remains ongoing
Prepared release identifier: v1.0.0; cite a full commit SHA until the tag is published

## Reproduce the accepted analysis

```bash
pip install uv
uv sync --frozen
make reproduce
make test
```

`make reproduce` uses frozen local artifacts only. It makes no OpenAI API calls and no live TheNNT requests.

## Accepted manuscript models

- GPT-4o: `gpt-4o-2024-11-20`
- o3: `o3-2025-04-16`
- GPT-5: `gpt-5`

## Canonical artifacts

- Dataset: `data/curated/diagnostic_lrs_manuscript_v1.csv`
- Model outputs: `data/model_outputs/manuscript_model_outputs_v1.csv`
- Threshold outputs: `data/model_outputs/threshold_perturbation_v1/`
- Model configuration: `config/manuscript_models_v1.json`
- Main prompt: `prompts/main_estimator_v1.json`
- Threshold prompt: `prompts/threshold_perturbation_v1.json`
- Manifest: `manifests/manuscript_run_v1.json`
- Reference results: `results/reference/`
- Main analysis: `data_analysis.ipynb`
- Supplementary analysis: `supplementary_analyses.ipynb`
- Pre-production author-manuscript text: `llms-full.txt`

## Replication boundary

A live rerun is a new replication, not reproduction of the accepted paper. It requires an API key, explicit models, a call ceiling, typed confirmation, and a new immutable directory under `runs/`. It must never overwrite the frozen workbooks, prompts, model outputs, or reference results. See `docs/REPLICATION.md`.

## Safety and reuse

Do not add API keys, restricted data, private correspondence, publisher proofs, local execution artifacts, or unreviewed drafts. MIT covers original repository software only. TheNNT-derived values and model outputs retain their distinct provenance and reuse boundaries. `llms-full.txt` is shared separately under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and is not the Version of Record.
